blocks.title: Follow progress.
blocks.lead: Etesian is built one part at a time. The ROM’s latest published release is {{rom.version}} ({{rom.date}}). Work built since then is listed under “Built since the latest release” until a newer release includes it.

items.detail: Launcher, home views, Events, lock screen, gestures, status menu, notification styles, keyboard, Belle widgets and the restyled apps. Signed builds from CI.
Standalone APK for any Android phone.
LineageOS 24 with Etesian as a Redroid-style Docker image, boot-tested before each release.
Tokens, Vue components and the desktop shell on GitHub Packages, with the Storybook at language.etesian-design.com.
The pages, and the interactive desktop and phone under Try.
A Phorepoc project with its own releases: a Raspberry Pi image, binaries and an install script.
The floating button and menu that replaces Side Sense.
The whole screen at half size.
The News view and search everything in Applications.
Etesian’s own interface sounds and tones; the water-drop boot animation.
Edit mode from a long press anywhere, hold-to-peek, per-side swipe targets.
The N9 dial pad, the Contacts menu, Meeye icons as the default, selection sheets in Settings.
Not in a release yet: squircle controls, flash strip, card flip, settings page and panels, zoom slider.
The N9-style standby screen, as an Android screen saver. Not in the development tree yet.
The wallpaper and style pickers with N9 switches.
Working on Plasma 6.6 and newer; no packages yet.
Any phone LineageOS 24 supports needs its own build. Only the Pro1-X has one.
